risk_summary: The company reports persistent losses, negative operating cash flow, declining cash balances, and dependence on additional financing to continue clinical development and commercialization. Liquidity appears constrained, with Form S-3 and at-the-market financing capacity currently impaired and explicit risk of abandoning efforts if capital is unavailable. Although the disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail, it relies on uncertain funding and regulatory assumptions.
